access_review.scope: Turning a double-faced permanent to its other face using Convert.
access_review.summary: The reviewed Transformers cards use Convert in white, blue, black and red, with green appearing in multicolor combinations.

W.note: Prowl converts when a player plays a card it exiled; Ratchet can convert when you gain life. Both are white on their two faces.

U.note: Jetfire’s blue faces can convert through activated abilities. Jetfire, Air Guardian also adapts after converting.

B.note: Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant converts after dealing combat damage to a player. Starscream, Seeker Leader converts when you become the monarch.

R.note: Slicer, High-Speed Antagonist converts at end of combat after dealing combat damage to a player. Both Slicer faces are red.

G.note: Blaster is red-green, and Ultra Magnus is red-green-white. Their Convert abilities establish those combinations; no monogreen example was found in this review.

combinations.note: Flamewar, Brash Veteran converts when you sacrifice another artifact to its activated ability.
Blaster, Combat DJ converts when one or more +1/+1 counters are put on it.
Cyclonus, Cybertronian Fighter converts after dealing combat damage to a player, then can give you an additional beginning phase.
Megatron, Tyrant can convert in a postcombat main phase to add colorless mana based on life opponents lost that turn.
Arcee, Sharpshooter converts after its activated ability removes counters to deal damage to a creature.
Ultra Magnus, Tactician can put an artifact creature from your hand onto the battlefield attacking, then convert at end of combat.
Goldbug, Humanity’s Ally converts when you cast your second spell in a turn.
Soundwave, Superior Captain converts when you cast a spell and creates one of its named Robot tokens depending on the spell’s mana value.
Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader can convert after the creature chosen by its bolster ability deals combat damage to a player.

colorless.note: No colorless example was found among the reviewed paper cards.

limitations: Colors describe the card or face that supplies the mechanic, not the colors of creatures that can receive it or mana needed to activate it. Multicolor examples remain combination evidence.
The vehicle faces retain their printed color indicators. Grimlock’s instruction to convert a Transformers toy is outside this review of the rules action.

candidate_accounting.method: Union of separately captured keyword and exact Oracle-term searches, deduplicated by oracle_id; released-format query selects an in-scope printing. Every candidate has a screening result. Generic rules vocabulary is not treated as a card population.

Heroes of the Realm commemorative cards are outside this paper-card review.

candidate_accounting.method: Union of separately captured keyword and exact Oracle-term searches, deduplicated by oracle_id; released-format query selects an in-scope printing. Every candidate has a screening result. Generic rules vocabulary is not treated as a card population.

access_review.scope: The cumulative upkeep keyword and effects that explicitly grant it.
access_review.summary: The reviewed cards use cumulative upkeep in all five colors and on colorless cards. Each upkeep adds an age counter, increasing the total payment needed to keep the permanent.

limitations: Colors describe the card or face that supplies the mechanic, not the colors of creatures that can receive it or mana needed to activate it. Multicolor examples remain combination evidence.

access_review.scope: Conjure actions and explicit grants on released digital cards, including actions described by double team.
access_review.summary: The reviewed digital cards conjure named cards, spellbook cards or duplicates. Examples occur in all five colors, multicolor combinations and colorless cards.

W.note: Dragonfly Pilot conjures a Dragonfly Suit into your hand when it enters. The source card is white, regardless of the conjured card’s colors.

U.note: Agent of Raffine can conjure a duplicate of an opponent’s top library card into your hand, then exile that original card.

B.note: Boneyard Aberration can exile itself when it dies to conjure three Reassembling Skeleton cards into your graveyard.

R.note: Brave Meadowguard conjures a Might of the Meek into your hand when it enters.

G.note: A Golden Opportunity conjures Gilded Goose in its first chapter; its later chapters can conjure Golden Egg.

combinations.note: Furgul, Quag Nurturer conjures Slimy Dualleech at your end step if you control no Leeches.
Dazzling Flameweaver conjures a random spellbook card into exile after creatures you control deal combat damage to a player.
Darigaaz, Shivan Champion conjures a random spellbook card into exile with egg counters, delaying its arrival on the battlefield.
The Next Iteration spell on Rootha, Ardent Artisan conjures a random artifact with mana value one greater than X onto the battlefield. That spell face is red-green.
Bind to Secrecy has a mode that conjures a duplicate of a creature card in an opponent’s graveyard into your hand.
Nashi, Illusion Gadgeteer conjures a duplicate of a secretly chosen card from your graveyard into your hand.
Anina, Natural Parallelist conjures a random creature with mana value X when you cast a spell with X in its mana cost.
Indris, the Hydrostatic Surge conjures four Lightning Bolts into your library and gives them storm before shuffling.
Glorifying Verse can conjure another Glorifying Verse into your hand when you cast an instant or sorcery that targets a creature.
Call the Crash conjures two Siege Rhinos onto the battlefield.
Kithkin Brinefarer conjures a duplicate when a Kithkin card goes from your library to your hand.
Jewel Mine Overseer conjures seven Seven Dwarves into your library and gives each a card-draw ability before shuffling.
Ace Flockbringer conjures a duplicate into your hand when you cast a creature without flying, giving that duplicate flying.
Sliver Weftwinder gives your Slivers an enters ability that conjures a random Slivers Spellbook card into your library before drawing a card.
Vv’viza, Orbital Overseer conjures a card you choose from the Planets Spellbook onto the battlefield when it enters.

colorless.note: Gixian Recycler can conjure another Gixian Recycler into your graveyard when it dies or goes there from your hand or library. The card itself is colorless.

limitations: Colors describe the card or face that supplies the mechanic, not the colors of creatures that can receive it or mana needed to activate it. Multicolor examples remain combination evidence.
These are digital-card examples. Cards that only reward conjuring are excluded. Paper playtest versions and cards created by conjuring do not establish additional colors for the source ability.
